cpu_hours_note: CPU time of ONE full replay of all 136 records: 269 runs, every record replayed exactly once (large records split into pieces), spread over two machines; summed from the cpu_seconds reported by replay4d. Per-record values are in results[].cpu_hours.
cpu_by_kind_note: replay4d does not time leaf kinds separately, so CPU time per kind is not recorded; leaves_by_kind gives the number of leaves of each kind.
